chunks: Who will make me die, then give me life again,
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God giving death and life?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited as a concise proof for the bodily resurrection (al-Ba'th al-Jasadi), affirming that the One who causes death is fully capable of restoring the same creation. It underscores the continuity of divine power from the initial act of taking life to the final act of reviving it, serving as a foundational argument against those who deny the physical reality of the Hereafter.
